verdict.rationale: Glama's hosting/gateway lets deployed MCP servers run as always-on headless endpoints, and the pricing page mentions automating workflows via schedules or webhooks, suggesting some non-interactive automation support. However there's no documented CLI, API/OpenAPI spec (probe shows 404s), or explicit CI integration guidance, so it's unclear how an AI-native user would drive Glama itself headlessly in a pipeline. Missing for 10: CLI/API docs for headless control, explicit CI/CD integration examples, and independent confirmation of the schedules/webhooks automation feature.
